screenLevelIssues.explanation: The screen implementation uses a uniform horizontal padding (likely 24px) for all sections. Figma specifies variable padding zones: Header, Recent Payments, and Bottom Bar use 32px padding, while the Title Section ('Your rent is due...') and Carousel start inset use 64px padding to create a narrower, focused column.
screenLevelIssues.currentCode:
// Code not provided
<View style={{ paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg }}>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The horizontal card carousel in Figma starts with a 64px left inset to align with the title text, and has a 32px right inset. The simulator shows standard uniform padding.

Two structural elements are missing from the screen between the Carousel and the Recent Payments list: 1) The Pagination Dots (Frame 2095586316) below the cards. 2) The 'Recent Payments / Cashbacks' Toggle Switch (Frame 3120) above the list.
The screen background in Figma is a dark grey (#131313), while the simulator appears to be using pure black (#000000), reducing the contrast with the cards.

feedback.explanation: Update screen background color to match Figma theme.
Apply mixed padding zones: 32px (spacing.xl) for Header/Recent/Bottom, and 64px (spacing.huge) for Title/Carousel start.
Carousel content container needs specific insets to align with title.
feedback.fixedCode: contentContainerStyle={{ paddingLeft: spacing.huge, paddingRight: spacing.xl, gap: spacing.md }}

feedback.explanation: Insert missing Pagination Dots below carousel and Toggle Switch above Recent Payments list.
feedback.fixedCode:
<Carousel />
<PaginationDots style={{ marginTop: spacing.md }} />
<View style={{ gap: spacing.xxxl, paddingHorizontal: spacing.xl }}>
  <ToggleSwitch options={['Recent Payments', 'Cashbacks']} />
  <RecentPayments />
</View>
